# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC19 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28
Host route: local macOS sandbox, `TERM=dumb`, `transport=ssh`, `tmux=no`
Git provenance: unavailable in this workspace (`git status --short` reports `fatal: not a git repository`)

## Scope

RC19 adds an on-demand dirty-buffer review surface for the iPad/Blink IDE workflow:

- `Esc w d` maps to `workspace.dirty-buffers`.
- `:dirty`, `:dirty-buffers`, `:dirtybuffers`, `:modified`, and `:unsaved` open the same view.
- The view is read-only and lists modified buffers with active-source marking, buffer kind, character count, line count, and path/name.
- It reports the open/dirty buffer counts and next actions for Save All, buffer switching, Buffer Info, and quit confirmation.
- Opening it does not save, discard, stage, run tasks, request LSP work, or mutate source text.
- README and iPad/Blink QA docs now list the dirty-buffer review routes and the updated automated evidence.

This keeps multi-file unsaved-work review available without a persistent sidebar, matching the streamlined full-IDE direction for narrow iPad terminal sessions.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint proves local source behavior, action-layer reachability, command parsing, read-only dirty-buffer review generation, release build, offline packaging, and local binary health.

It does **not** prove real iPad Magic Keyboard delivery, Blink Shell key decoding, mosh/SSH reconnect feel, OSC 52 routing, touch/trackpad behavior, tmux operation, or a real language-server workflow. The real hardware acceptance gate remains open in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
